mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,operation_id,subject_id,operation_name,idempotency_key,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref, target_id,error_code,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at, dedup_expires_at,dedup_policy_revision FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='RV-06-ANCHOR-RECONCILE-1' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE aggregate_id=#{annotationId} AND aggregate_revision=#{resulting} AND event_type='annotation.anchor.reconciled'

SELECT invalidation_id AS invalidationId,review_id AS reviewId,trigger_version AS triggerVersion,reason_code AS reasonCode FROM review_invalidation i WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND trigger_version=#{artifactId} AND reason_code='ANNOTATION_ANCHOR_RECONCILED' ORDER BY review_id FOR UPDATE
